A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.start_timestamp_ms}}) AS start_ms,
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_ms}}) AS end_ms,
  series AS (
    SELECT fingerprint,
           any(if(JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name') != '', JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.name'), JSONExtractString(labels, 'host.id'))) AS host,
           any(JSONExtractString(labels, 'outcome')) AS outcome
    FROM signoz_metrics.time_series_v4
    WHERE metric_name = 'loom.ci_telemetry.cycles'
    GROUP BY fingerprint
  ),
  per_host AS (
    SELECT series.host AS host,
           count() AS cycles,
           countIf(series.outcome = 'ok') AS ok_cycles,
           min(s.unix_milli) AS first_ms,
           max(s.unix_milli) AS last_ms
    FROM signoz_metrics.samples_v4 AS s
    INNER JOIN series USING (fingerprint)
    WHERE s.metric_name = 'loom.ci_telemetry.cycles'
      AND s.unix_milli >= start_ms
      AND s.unix_milli < end_ms
    GROUP BY host
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ms, 1000)) AS ts,
       host,
       toFloat64(1) AS value
FROM per_host
WHERE ok_cycles = 0
  AND first_ms <= start_ms + 600000
  AND last_ms >= end_ms - 1800000
ORDER BY host

annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} ran CI telemetry poll cycles throughout the last 2 h (loom.ci_telemetry.cycles, latest within 30 min) and none finished with outcome=ok: every cycle was busy, rate-limited, credential-rejected, discovery_failed, io_failed or panicked. A host with no cycles at all (no poller) is never judged, and a poller started inside the window is not judged until it has failed for the whole window. Look at the outcome label of the failing cycles and `status.json` consecutive failures (478 since 2026-10-17 went unseen). Issues #12908, #12792.
